newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr up slightly vs yen but trade quiet in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dlr up slightly vs yen but trade quiet in Tokyo.

text.p: *Dollar slightly higher against yen in morning Tokyo but trade subdued amid dearth of fresh factors and ahead of long holiday weekend in United States.
*Some investment management trust firms may be placing bids in connection with the setting up of new foreign bond funds.
*Some exporters keen to sell dollars near 114 yen, capping greenback's rises for now.
*"Trade is very quiet today. Trading energy ebbed ahead of the holiday in the U.S.," said a trust bank dealer.
*Talk of options positions with knock-in price of 64.50 yen in mark/yen trade. If mark touches that point, it will allow holders of options to sell marks near 67 yen.
*German currency stood near 64.94/97 yen at 0140 GMT, compared with 64.87 yen in late New York trade on Thursday.
0005 GMT-*Dollar moving narrowly in early Tokyo trade after falling against other major currencies in New York on Thursday.

*Dollar fell on Thursday in New York as expectations of near-term increase in U.S. interest rates faded after U.S. employment report showed an uptick in unemployment rate to 5.0 percent in June from 4.8 percent in May.
*There was talk that some Japanese life insurers sold dollars in a large lot, probably for hedging purposes, after U.S. jobs data was released, traders said.
*Dollar/mark's downside seen limited as mark likely to remain weak versus sterling and yen, traders said.
